description: Source code for an Android activity class 'MyRssReader5' that displays RSS feed items, handles user interactions, and manages UI components such as ListView and WebView.

classes.name: MyRssReader5
classes.description: Main activity class for RSS reader, managing UI and user interactions.

classes.name: RssCursorAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for displaying RSS items with special formatting for unread items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up ListView and WebView, and queries RSS data.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of RSS items, loads content into WebView.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles case when no RSS item is selected, displays default message.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with start/stop service, add, delete, update options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for starting/stopping service, adding, deleting, requerying RSS.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from adding new RSS item, inserts into content provider, and triggers requery.
